rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for an organized club or member association.

example.english: There’s a tennis club near our home.
example.traditional: 我哋屋企附近有個網球俱樂部。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 fu6 gan6 jau5 go3 mong5 kau4 keoi1 lok6 bou6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a nightclub rather than an ordinary bar or music venue.

example.english: We’re going to the club tonight to watch a song-and-dance show.
example.traditional: 我哋今晚去夜總會睇歌舞表演。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 je6 zung2 wui2 tai2 go1 mou5 biu2 jin2

rows.note: Use this fixed food term for a club sandwich.

example.english: I had a club sandwich for lunch.
example.traditional: 我晏晝食咗個公司三文治。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aan3 zau3 sik6 zo2 go3 gung1 si1 saam1 man4 zi6

rows.note: Use this for the clubs suit symbol in playing cards.

example.english: I have a club in my hand.
example.jyutping: ni1 pou1 ngo5 jau5 zoeng1 mui4 faa1
